entries.793f7073b13cc72e: A company that, built on the comprehensive beauty and cosmetics site "@cosme", sells cosmetics through EC and stores and provides marketing support for cosmetics brands.
entries.db5706134859a2b0: This business is not included in reportable segments and engages in a staffing business dispatching beauty advisers, BtoC paid services for users, an investment and development business investing in companies at growth stages, and a supplement business, among others. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,272 million.
entries.de27db5bce74bdbb: Built on the comprehensive cosmetics and beauty website “@cosme,” this business provides advertising solutions for cosmetics brands and data-driven solutions that make use of accumulated data. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥12,083 million.
